use_notifier.description: If true, jamJAR will use /Applications/Utilities/Notifier.app for notifications.
use_notifier.title: Use Notifier?

message_title.description: The title used within any delivered messages.
message_title.title: Message Title

notify_installed.title: Notify the logged in user when a title has been installed.

installed_notification_type.title: Notification type for notifying a title has been installed.

installed_message.description: The placeholders %DISPLAYNAME% and %DISPLAYVERSION% can be used for these notifications. Default: %DISPLAYNAME% %DISPLAYVERSION% has been installed.
installed_message.title: Message to display when a title has been installed.

Pending Install Messages.description: Settings for the pending install messages.

notify_pending_install.title: Notify the logged in user when a title is pending installation.

notify_pending_install_type.title: Notification type for notifying a title is pending install.

pending_install_message.default: One or more items are pending installation. Click here for more information or log out and the pending items will be installed.
pending_install_message.description: The placeholder %DISPLAYPENDING% can be used for these notifications, to show the number of pending items. Default: One or more items are pending installation. Click here for more information or log out and the pending items will be installed.
pending_install_message.title: Message to display when a title is pending installation.

pending_install_message_frequency.description: Frequency of which pending install messages are posted.
pending_install_message_frequency.title: Frequency of which pending install messages are posted to the logged in user.

pending_logout_install_button.description: Adds a logout button to the pending install message when enabled.
pending_logout_install_button.title: If true, a logout button is added to the pending install message.

pending_logout_install_button_text.description: Sets the text displayed on the logout button. Default: Logout.
pending_logout_install_button_text.title: Sets the text displayed on the logout button.

Pending Uninstall Messages.description: Settings for the pending uninstall messages.

notify_pending_uninstall.title: Notify the logged in user when a title is pending uninstallation.

notify_pending_uninstall_type.title: Notification type for notifying a title has been pending.

pending_uninstall_message.default: One or more items are pending uninstallation. Click here for more information or log out and the pending items will be uninstalled.
pending_uninstall_message.description: The placeholder %DISPLAYPENDING% can be used for these notifications, to show the number of pending items. Default: One or more items are pending uninstallation. Click here for more information or log out and the pending items will be uninstalled.
pending_uninstall_message.title: Message to display when a title is pending uninstallation.

pending_uninstall_message_frequency.description: Frequency of which pending uninstall messages are posted.
pending_uninstall_message_frequency.title: Frequency of which pending uninstall messages are posted to the logged in user.

pending_logout_uninstall_button.title: If true, a logout button is added to the pending uninstall message.

pending_logout_uninstall_button_text.title: Sets the text displayed on the logout button.

notify_uninstalled.title: Notify the logged in user when a title has been uninstalled.

uninstalled_notification_type.description: Notification type to use when notifying a title has been uninstalled.
uninstalled_notification_type.title: Notification type for notifying a title has been uninstalled.

notify_uninstalled_message.description: The placeholder %DISPLAYNAME% can be used for these notifications. Default: %DISPLAYNAME% has been uninstalled.
notify_uninstalled_message.title: Message to display when a title has been uninstalled.

notify_up_to_date.title: Notify the logged in user when and install is attempted via Self Service, but the version installed is the latest version available.

up_to_date_notification_type.title: Notification type for notifying a title is up-to-date

notify_up_to_date_message.default: The latest version of %DISPLAYNAME% is installed.
notify_up_to_date_message.description: The placeholder %DISPLAYNAME% can be used for these notifications. Default: The latest version of %DISPLAYNAME% is installed.
notify_up_to_date_message.title: Message to display when an install is attempted via Self Service but the version installed is the latest version available.
